scenario: LDIA.3.5.1 / LCAP.3.8 — the resolved settings must satisfy the fundamental constraints, and the compiler switches nothing on to repair them. `base` sets every capability false; turning on `nocooldown` without `call` violates `nocooldown` requires `call`, so the file is DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_CONSTRAINT although nothing in it uses either. Drives the constraint check, which runs before per-construct validation.
rules_ds:
use base:
    nocooldown: true

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key
